answer_1.quote: In open-domain dialogue generation, these GNNs are further embedded into generative frameworks to feed graph knowledge features into the language models (LMs).
datasets: commonsense knowledge graph enhanced dialogue generation dataset

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We adopt the metrics of BLEU, NIST, METEOR, Dist, and Ent for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Three human evaluators are instructed to give their preferred response on 100 randomly sampled conversational pairs.
answer_4.guideline: examine the appropriateness (whether the response is appropriate in the context) and informativeness (whether the response contains much information)
